clues.text: This huge city sits among hills and steep peaks. The steep peak Bukhansan rises at its north edge.
clues.narrowing: Rules out flat coastal cities; puts the player among steep hills under a peak called Bukhansan.

source.quote: Seoul is geographically set in a mountainous and hilly terrain, with Bukhansan positioned on its northern edge.

clues.text: Monsoon rains soak this city in summer, and typhoons can strike too. Winters flip to cold, dry air with days of snow.
clues.narrowing: Rules out even climates; keeps a monsoon city with wet summers and cold, dry winters.

source.quote: Summers are hot and humid, with the East Asian monsoon taking place from June until July and typhoons taking place any time between July and September.

clues.text: In 1394, a new king chose this place and planned it as his dynasty's capital. Work crews soon raised palaces and a fortress wall.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals planned from scratch by a new dynasty in 1394.

source.quote: Seoul became the planned capital of Korea by Yi Seong-gye , the founding father of the Joseon dynasty.

clues.text: Old royal palaces stand among tall glass towers in this city. The wide Han River winds along beside them all.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: old royal palaces among glass towers, by the Han River.

source.quote: some major palaces, including Gyeongbokgung , were finished in 1395.

clues.text: This city is the capital of South Korea. Its top court ruled it must stay the capital of the land.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the top court ruled this city must remain the national capital.

source.quote: the Constitutional Court of Korea declared in 2004 that Seoul must remain the national capital

reveal.blurb: People of the Baekje kingdom first founded a town here long ago. In 1394 a new dynasty planned it as the capital, with palaces and a great wall. War later left it in ruins, but it rebuilt fast and hosted the Olympics in 1988. Seoul is the capital of South Korea.
